summary: Verified backend email-provider endpoints, Gmail OAuth authorize/disconnect, weekly digest 'Upcoming meetings' section, and frontend Email setup wizard (provider switching + save toast). 8/8 pytest tests passed and all UI checks succeeded.

issues: React hydration warning: <span> child of <option> in digest hour/minute <select> (data-testid=digest-hour). Non-blocking but noisy in console.

action_items: Optional: remove wrapping <span> around <option> children inside digest hour/minute selects to fix React hydration warning.
critical_code_review_comments: gmail_oauth.py PUT /admin/email-provider does not validate 'sender' as an email — currently accepts any 200-char string. Consider basic regex validation.
services/gmail.py Flow.from_client_config uses scopes=None on token exchange; fine but relies on Google echoing scopes — acceptable.
Admin.jsx is 1543 lines — should be split into per-tab modules for maintainability.
seed_data_creation: None (persisted email_provider state is restored to provider=gmail at end of test)
context_for_next_testing_agent: Backend endpoints verified: GET/PUT /api/admin/email-provider, GET /api/admin/gmail/authorize (returns accounts.google.com URL), POST /api/admin/gmail/disconnect, GET /api/admin/digest/preview?frequency=weekly (contains 'Upcoming meetings'), GET /api/admin/digest/history. Frontend wizard at Admin > 'Site Note' tab (id=sitenote): sender defaults to admin@godesk.io, resend-fallback-toggle OFF by default, provider cards switch Step-2 config between gmail-config and smtp-config-wizard, 'Save email settings' shows success toast. Actual email send not tested (out of scope per request).
